:::{#def-commutative}
#### Commutative operation

An operation $\star$ on a set $S$ (@def-identity-element)
is **commutative**
if $a \star b = b \star a$ for all $a, b \in S$:
the order of the two inputs does not matter.
Some sources, including the titles of @thm-sum-symmetric and @thm-prod-symmetric,
call a commutative operation **symmetric**.

:::
